description.p: DeckFlix is a minimal desktop wrapper for netflix.com built for the big screen: it loads the real Netflix web app and layers a custom spatial navigator on top, so the entire UI can be driven with a game controller or TV remote. No keyboard required.

Playback uses the Widevine CDM (installed automatically on first launch by the castlabs Electron runtime). On Linux, Widevine L3 limits streaming resolution to about 720p — this is a platform limitation, not an app limitation.
Initial release: spatial navigator (browse + player modes), gamepad/remote input bus, Flatpak packaging.
